Below are the tuition costs for GSAS programs for the 2026-2027 academic year.
PhD Programs
The 2026-2027 tuition rate for Graduate School of Arts and Sciences PhD students is $5,201 per semester. Please visit the Student Financial Services website and their page on Cost of Attendance for Graduate School.
Tuition for Graduate School of Arts and Sciences PhD students is fully covered by Tufts tuition scholarships. PhD students are also eligible for federal loans to cover the cost of living expenses. In addition, many departments/programs offer research or teaching assistantships with admission. To learn more about specific PhD program packages, applicants should contact the graduate director of the program to which they are applying.
Note: Students enrolled in a PhD program are provided a subsidy for the full cost of Tufts Student Health Insurance and the Health and Wellness fee for five years and for eligible sixth year students.
Master's Programs
GSAS bills tuition using a per-credit billing model, meaning you are billed for the number of credits you take each semester. This billing model is used to provide students better flexibility so they may "pay-as-they-go".
Select a program below for the cost of tuition per credit for the 2026-2027 academic year.

To calculate your estimated tuition for a semester, you need to multiply the per-credit cost of your program by the number of credits you plan to take that semester. Please visit the Student Financial Services website and their page on Cost of Attendance for Graduate School.
The Graduate School of Arts and Sciences provides students with tuition scholarships to help with the cost of your degree. To learn more about our process and generous tuition scholarships, contact Graduate Admissions at gradadmissions@tufts.edu.
Occupational Therapy Doctoral Programs
The Entry-Level Occupational Therapy Doctorate and the Post-Professional Occupational Therapy Doctorate use a per-credit billing model, meaning you are billed for the number of credits you take each semester.
The 2026-2027 per credit tuition for the Entry-Level Occupational Therapy Doctorate is $1,299. The 2026-2027 per credit tuition for the Post-Professional Occupational Therapy Doctorate is $1,299.
To calculate your estimated tuition for a semester, you need to multiply the per-credit cost of your program by the number of credits you plan to take that semester. Please visit the Student Financial Services website and their page on Cost of Attendance for Graduate School.
The Graduate School of Arts and Sciences provides students with tuition scholarships to help with the cost of your degree. To learn more about our process and generous tuition scholarships, contact Graduate Admissions at gradadmissions@tufts.edu.
Certificate Programs
The 2026-2027 tuition for most certificates offered by the Graduate School of Arts and Sciences is $1,049 per credit. The rate also applies to courses taken in the summer.
Please visit the Student Financial Services website and their page on Cost of Attendance for Graduate School.
Post-Baccalaureate Programs
The 2026-2027 tuition for the Post-Baccalaureate Mathematics certificate is $1,049 per credit.
Tuition for the Post-Baccalaureate certificate in Studio Art is billed at a flat rate semi-annually. The 2026-2027 tuition for the Post-Baccalaureate in Studio Art is $47,886 (or $23,943 per semester). The School of the Museum of Fine Arts at Tufts University and the Graduate School of Arts and Sciences provide tuition scholarships to high achieving applicants to the Post-Bacc in Studio Art. To learn more about our process and generous tuition scholarships, contact SMFA Admissions at SMFAgradadmissions@tufts.edu.
Tuition for the Post-Baccalaureate Pre-Health certificate is billed semi-annually and only during the first year of the program. Tuition for students entering the Post-Baccalaureate Pre-Health certificate during the 2026-2027 academic year is $47,724 (or $23,862 per semester). This covers the tuition of the entire program (up to 10 approved courses), and no bills are issued during a students’ second year of study.
Please visit the Student Financial Services website and their page on Cost of Attendance for Graduate School.

Ancillary Fees for GSAS
A Graduate Student Activity Fee is assessed to students in master's and doctoral programs to support the activities of the Graduate Student Council. The 2026-2027 Graduate Student Activity Fee is $31 per semester ($62 per academic year). This fee is not charged to certificate students or students enrolled in fully online programs.
A Student Health Insurance Plan (SHIP) premium is assessed for comprehensive individual medical and mental health coverage. Students have the option to purchase additional coverage for spouses, domestic partners, and children directly through the health insurance carrier. Students who are admitted full-time and part-time students registered for seven (7) or more credits in residential (including hybrid) programs are automatically enrolled in SHIP while tuition is being charged. Students enrolled in fully online programs are not eligible for SHIP. The insurance may be waived if proof of outside comparable coverage from a US carrier is submitted by the deadline. Please visit the Student Health Insurance page for the updated premium for the academic year, as well as the final date for waiving SHIP.
A Student Health and Wellness (SHAW) Fee is mandatory for students who are admitted full-time, and part-time students registered for seven (7) or more credits in residential (including hybrid) programs. This fee covers the use of Tufts Health Service, Counseling and Mental Health Service (CMHS), the Center for Awareness, Resources, and Education (CARE), and Health Promotion and Prevention (HPP), all on the Medford/Somerville campus. This fee is assessed per semester while tuition is still being charged. Students enrolled in fully online programs are not charged the SHAW fee, and are not eligible for services at Health Service, CMHS, or CARE. Please visit the SHAW webpage for updated per-semester charges.
.
Continuation Policies and Fees for GSAS
All students will be charged continuation tuition for each semester after their expected degree completion period (two years for most master's students; three years for master's students in occupational therapy (entry-level program), school psychology, and urban and environmental policy and planning; three years for entry-level OTD students; and six years for PhD students). The 2026-2027 continuation tuition is $1,200 per semester.
We will provide the earliest possible notification of changes in tuition and other fees. Most tuition rate changes are effective in the fall term each academic year. The Entry-Level OTD Program, which starts in the summer, has tuition rate changes at the beginning of the summer term. The Trustees of Tufts College reserve the right to change the tuition or to establish additional fees or charges for special features or services whenever such action is deemed advisable.
